title: Apple And Microsoft's Overseas Cash Pile - Feria Investor's Hector Andres Pacheco's Idea Of The Month - Seeking Alpha
text:
Feria Investor on Twitter Summary 
We have extended our partnership with Cheddar TV to produce a Seeking Alpha "Idea of the Month" segment. 
Feria Investor's Hector Andres Pacheco continues the series with his idea of the month: how the new tax bill will impact special dividends given out by big companies - in particular, Apple and Microsoft. 
The tax bill will allow US companies to bring back money from overseas at a reduced tax price. Apple and Microsoft are prime contenders for a special dividend. See Feria Investor's earlier article on Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) and the new tax bill here . About this article:
